topology.crossStore: Stable soft references plus explicit validators; no cross-database FK or assumed distributed SQL transaction
topology.control: Separate unversioned context/database with new additive chains for all four supported providers; control requests, receipts, enrollment, host config, audit and allocator
topology.authentication: Retain existing separate Identity database and grants/configuration stores; never clone
topology.standalone: Existing full McpDbContext and historical migrations on the original providers; fourth provider has its own new baseline
topology.transactionSecurity: Retain existing separate operational QuadBrain store; no federation apply/control dependency on coordinator health
topology.project: Dolt-only context containing approved versioned projections, immutable ProjectId and safe in-project relationships; no audit/index/credential/control tables

limitations: This is a proposed classification design pending B2/B3 review and real provider evidence, not migration instructions or a done claim
EF InMemory metadata does not verify SQL types, relational table naming, indexes/constraints enforcement, provider-specific model differences or live databases
Writer and assignment locations are syntax candidates; per-method call-target and enclosing-flow verification is still incomplete
Raw SQL, indirect storage factories and transitive/background entrypoints need closure review beyond the named call patterns

GraphRAG/source ingestion, tools, product registry and operational workflow records are proposed retained operational data; no row is deleted and no authored graph/source content is called rebuildable
IdentityServer configuration/persisted grants stores and migrations must also be inventoried; the inherited ASP.NET Identity model alone is not their inventory
B4 exact ID grammar and all acceptance/real-engine measurements remain separate pending outputs
